expect:
Mr of repeating unit = Mr of acid + Mr of diol − Mr of water lost (1 mark)
= 130 + 62 − 18 = 174 (1 mark)
value:
Mr of repeating unit = Mr of acid + Mr of diol − (2 × Mr of water) (1 mark)
= 130 + 62 − 36 = 156 (1 mark). The acid and the diol join at both ends, so two water molecules are lost from each repeating unit.
note: F7: a polyester repeating unit loses two water molecules, not one. Check with PET: 166 + 62 = 228 and the repeat unit is 192, a loss of 36.
